title: Forge and hammer
label: Coal forge and power hammer on a base board: anvil, lipped table with a glowing coal bed, firebox hood and chimney, cranked blower, coal bucket, quench tub, and a belt-driven hammer over a hot billet in tongs.
caption: The blower drives the coal bed to 1,325 °C and brings the bar to a yellow forging heat; each blow of the ram flattens it (40 mm to 32 mm) and the quench tub takes it back to cold. Move across the figure: left taps the tub, centre holds the fire, right holds the hammer.
